app.name: MAME4Wii (VTech V.Smile)
app.long_description:
MAME 0.289 for the Nintendo Wii.
Put ROM sets (zip/7z) in sd:/mame4wii/roms or usb:/mame4wii/roms. Controls: Wii Remote (sideways), Wii Remote + Nunchuk, Classic Controller, Wii U Pro Controller, GameCube controllers (including the Wii U adapter), USB keyboard and mouse. HOME opens the MAME menu; Minus+Plus opens the on-screen keyboard.
